Gunite Services GUNITE SERVICES Because of our once innovative design, now the standard in dry-mix application, we have shot thousands of swimming pool shells and are able to confidently predict our product performance. We use only the highest quality cement and aggregate products from the largest local cement and aggregate producers in Texas. We continue to use only state of the art equipment and employ only the highest trained and experienced employees in the gunite industry. Learn More Shotcrete Services SHOTCRETE SERVICES Along with 38 plus years of pioneering achievements in the dry-shot gunite industry, A&B also offers our shotcrete services. While the two results are very similar, their applications and desired results are different. Gunite is a “dry” application, in which coarse sand and dry cement are mixed with water added at the nozzle. Shotcrete uses “wet” concrete, pushed through a pneumatic pump which is then shot through a nozzle for its final application.
